aggressive_definition: Aggressive disease; operational criteria were not reported in the abstract.
aggressive_definition_excerpt: The inverse association between prostate cancer and α-tocopherol was restricted to current and recently former smokers, but was only slightly stronger for aggressive disease.
study_design: Nested case-control study within the PLCO Screening Trial
reason: The abstract reports overall incident prostate cancer risk and a separate association for aggressive disease. The aggressive endpoint is not operationally defined in the abstract. The supplied full-text evidence reports 267 aggressive cases. Although 680 cases and 824 controls are reported, total analytic N was not directly stated and was not inferred by addition.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Higher serum α-tocopherol was associated with significantly lower prostate cancer risk (OR for the highest vs. lowest quintile = 0.63, 95% CI 0.44-0.92, p-trend 0.05).
estimate_classifications.reason: This estimate is for overall prostate cancer risk, not the separately mentioned aggressive-disease analysis.
